title: 1895 C Humphrey Taylor built the Taylor block. (Later Ginsons and Lanyons)
description: Charles Humphrey Taylor, a merchant established in 1891, purchased land at the corner of Main Street and Station Street (later King Street, now Orser Street). He constructed a three-storey brick building crowned with a colored glass cupola and topped by a flagstaff. In December 1895, he moved into the building with his wife and child, occupying the top-floor apartment. Taylor was a member of the farmers' exchange, working to bring healthy, affordable food to his customers.
